title: OpenRTB 2.6 Imp
description: Describes an ad placement or impression being auctioned.

id.description: A unique identifier for this impression within the context of the bid request.

banner.description: A Banner object; required if this impression is offered as a banner ad opportunity.

video.description: A Video object; required if this impression is offered as a video ad opportunity.

audio.description: An Audio object; required if this impression is offered as an audio ad opportunity.

native.description: A Native object; required if this impression is offered as a native ad opportunity.

pmp.description: A Pmp object containing any private marketplace deals in effect for this impression.

displaymanager.description: Name of ad mediation partner, SDK technology, or player responsible for rendering ad.

displaymanagerver.description: Version of ad mediation partner, SDK technology, or player responsible for rendering ad.

instl.description: 1 = the ad is interstitial or full screen, 0 = not interstitial.

tagid.description: Identifier for specific ad placement or ad tag that was used to initiate the auction.

bidfloor.description: Minimum bid for this impression expressed in CPM.

bidfloorcur.description: Currency specified using ISO-4217 alpha codes.

clickbrowser.description: Indicates the type of browser opened upon clicking the creative in an app, where 0 = embedded, 1 = native.

secure.description: Flag to indicate if the impression requires secure HTTPS URL creative assets and markup.

iframebuster.description: Array of exchange-specific names of supported iframe busters.

rwdd.description: Indicates whether the user receives a reward for viewing the ad.

ssai.description: Indicates if server-side ad insertion is in use. 0 = unknown, 1 = all client-side, 2 = assets stitched server-side but tracking client-side, 3 = all server-side.

exp.description: Advisory as to the number of seconds that may elapse between the auction and the actual impression.

qty.description: A means of passing a multiplier in the bid request.

dt.description: Timestamp when the item is estimated to be fulfilled in Unix format (milliseconds since epoch).

refresh.description: Details about ad slots being refreshed automatically.

ext.description: Placeholder for exchange-specific extensions to OpenRTB.
